visual_action: A montage of clips from a large, indoor political rally for Kamala Harris. The video shows diverse and energetic supporters, many of whom are young, cheering, dancing, and holding signs. Signs include 'VOTE FOR FREEDOM' and 'KAMALA'. Kamala Harris is shown on stage waving and smiling, and also interacting with the crowd and taking photos with supporters. The atmosphere is celebratory and enthusiastic.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Kamala Harris is featured prominently throughout the video, on stage at a rally and taking photos with supporters.

cast.name: Tim Walz
cast.evidence: His name appears on a sign and a T-shirt alongside Kamala Harris's, e.g. 'HARRIS WALZ'.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video is posted by the official @democrats account and features their presidential candidate.

spoken_summary: The audio consists of upbeat pop/dance music. The lyrics in the second half of the clip include 'Don't give up,' 'I won't give up,' and 'no, no, no,' which mirror the text overlays on the screen. There is no spoken dialogue.
audio_music: The video features two continuous, upbeat, electronic dance tracks. The second track, starting around 6 seconds, is a sped-up pop song featuring motivational lyrics like 'Don't give up'. The overall effect is energetic, hopeful, and galvanizing.
editing_pacing: A fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various shots of the rally crowd and Kamala Harris.
cultural_references: The music features a sped-up version of the song 'The Greatest' by Sia.
central_claim: The campaign for Kamala Harris is backed by a large, diverse, and energetic base of supporters who are determined to see her win.
intended_effect: To energize viewers, project an image of a powerful and popular movement, and encourage support for the Democratic ticket.
